"""Plant synthetic sets roots (no real content) for S3's floors: argv[1] = base dir, argv[2] = head commit."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

base, head = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
BASE = {"decision": 5, "contract": 5, "plan": 5, "ticket": 5, "exact-string": 4, "callers": 2, "code-paraphrase": 2,
        "kernel-template": 3, "multi-file": 3, "failure-memory": 3, "history": 1, "nonexistent-id": 1}
assert sum(BASE.values()) == 39
VARIANTS = {
    "green": BASE,
    "callers1": {**BASE, "callers": 1, "exact-string": 5},
    "decision4": {**BASE, "decision": 4, "contract": 6},
    "shortfall-only-callers3": {**BASE, "callers": 3, "exact-string": 3},   # exact-string below its minimum: red
}
for label, spread in VARIANTS.items():
    root = base / label
    hidden = root / "fixtures/evaluation/memory-retrieval/hidden"
    hidden.mkdir(parents=True)
    root.chmod(0o700)
    n = 0
    for cat, count in spread.items():
        for _ in range(count):
            n += 1
            sources = [{"path": "README.md", "commit": head}]
            if cat == "multi-file":
                sources.append({"path": "CLAUDE.md", "commit": head})
            (hidden / f"s{n:02d}.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({
                "id": f"synthetic-{n:02d}", "category": cat, "question": f"synthetic question number {n} {cat}",
                "gold_answer": f"synthetic answer {n}", "sources": sources}), encoding="utf-8")
    assert n == 39
    print(label, n)
